title: Quick Peruvian Seafood Ceviche Clasico
description: A refreshing and energizing Peruvian dish featuring raw seafood marinated in a garlicky and creamy mixture with a hint of vanilla extract, served with crispy lamination-puff, this form of ceviche clasico is a classic
instructions: Rinse the shrimp and scallops under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, garlic, vanilla extract, and salt
Add the shrimp and scallops to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes
Just before serving, stir in the heavy cream
Arrange the crispy lamination-puff on a serving platter or individual plates
Spoon the ceviche mixture over the lamination-puff
Garnish with additional lime wedges if desired
